scope: merged-range candidate only; follow-up assessed separately
rationale: All five large pairs were slower. Evolved count and fill/sort costs increased in the separate trace while other major kernel costs and reported registers/local memory stayed close. The modest consistent small-workload saving does not justify making the targeted large workload slower. This is a workload and mechanism assessment, not a percentage cutoff or range-overlap rule.
limits: The hardware cause of the changed traversal cost is unresolved; no new counter access was available.
